platform: WREK Atlanta Official Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WREK officially accepts music by email at music.director@wrek.org and also lists a postal delivery route. A human must select the relevant track and delivery method, verify ownership, release status, broadcast suitability, metadata and any clean-version requirements, approve all personal data and files or links, reconfirm the published instructions and perform the submission manually. The optional physical route must not be treated as authorization to automate package delivery.

platform: KVRX 91.7 FM Official Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KVRX officially accepts digital and physical music submissions at music@kvrx.org but explicitly rejects AI-assisted or AI-generated music. A human must verify that the selected MarcsMusic track contains no AI-assisted or AI-generated elements before considering this route. If that requirement is not met, the queue item must be closed as ineligible. For an eligible track, a human must verify rights, release status, format, metadata and broadcast suitability, approve all personal data and perform the submission manually.
